_comment: SCA (src/ + xpi/) whose committed lock records tinylib at 1.2.2 while its resolved URL fetches the 1.2.1 tarball: the audit would ask about a release npm ci never installs. lockfile-injection reports the entry at its line and stops the review, so the lock is never audited: no OSV request, no CDN lookup, no parse. The URL is on the registry's tarball path, so the comparison is offline. The shipped background.js is minified, so sca-xpi-fully-included-in-archive would stay silent had the review gone on.
